limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by an agent that did not write or source-review the guide; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.

Run on the shared work2 lab (openlaw-docs-80ceef9e-work2), which other DOC-030 agents used at the same time. Only records named DOC-030 contracts-a were created. The fixture Fields, Contract types and Approver groups were archived after the run; the Contracts stay as named records. Pickers therefore also listed people other DOC-030 agents created.

API sessions created prerequisites (fixture types, Fields, groups, setup Contracts, a primary PDF), played the second actor's writes, and read back saved state and refusals. Every guide step ran in the browser as the named role. See walkthrough.json.

The Business User was Lena Vogel rather than Jonas Weber: the sign-in link budget is 3 per address in 15 minutes and other agents were spending Jonas Weber's links. She signed in to the Portal with a fresh magic link from the lab Mailpit.

Confirms the author's limitation on the V-C55 negative check: members may be any active user, and Business Users were offered and saved. The refusals checked instead were the archived member (editor error and API 422) and the Administrator-only page gate (Nadia Haddad sent to /settings/profile, API 403).
The archived member was a fixture Legal Team Member who was invited but never activated, then archived by the Administrator. No seeded account was archived.

Saving the editor with an archived member still ticked and no member change closes without error, because no member-list write is sent. The refusal appears on a member change; the guide's 'Remove that selection before saving a valid member list' holds.
The member-list failure after the description saved was induced with a routed 503 answer to the member-list write.
The organization override setting was changed in the browser for about three seconds and put back through the same card.

The Audit log entry for these configuration changes was not opened. The Members help text in the app still says 'Legal portal'; the guide says Approvals in the Portal navigation bar, which is what the Portal shows.
